mechanism_inventory: wrong-value / stale price path (fixed two-hop path may route through illiquid pool)
approval race / residual allowance (safeApprove non-zero-to-non-zero reverts)
external-call DoS (router call fails on insufficient liquidity)
cross-chain value invariant (amountOut used downstream for cross-chain credit)

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: minAmountOut is caller-supplied with no contract-level floor. A caller may pass minAmountOut=0; combined with caller-controlled destinationAddress, a sandwich/front-runner extracts nearly the entire swap value because the contract places no independent slippage bound.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Unprivileged miner/front-runner; or victim caller who set minAmountOut=0 and gets sandwiched.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. victim getZetaFromEth(dest,0) msg.value=X. 2. miner front-runs buying ZETA, inflating price. 3. victim swap at manipulated rate, near-zero ZETA. 4. miner back-runs selling ZETA, profiting victim's ETH. 5. amountOut near-zero; downstream cross-chain credit understated.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Caller/victim loses ETH (getZetaFromEth) or Zeta (getEthFromZeta) to sandwich.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: No contract-level floor on minAmountOut; contract trusts caller's slippage. Well-known Medium-to-High AMM-integration pattern.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: safeApprove(router, amount) without preceding approve(0). OZ safeApprove reverts on non-zero-to-non-zero. If a prior swap left residual allowance, the next safeApprove reverts, permanently bricking the swap path (no allowance-reset function).
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Unprivileged; contract itself is victim — any swap leaving residual allowance (fee-on-transfer/partial fill) bricks future swaps.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. getEthFromZeta partially fills / fee reduces consumed amount, leaving residual allowance>0. 2. next getEthFromZeta safeApprove reverts (allowance!=0). 3. all future getEthFromZeta/getZetaFromToken/getTokenFromZeta permanently bricked.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: All future callers — txns revert (no fund loss but permanent DoS).
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: safeApprove without approve(0); OZ reverts non-zero-to-non-zero; documented DoS in AMM wrappers; Medium (DoS with real victims).

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Cross-chain value understatement — amountOut returned used as authoritative cross-chain Zeta credit; sandwich-reduced amountOut under-credits destination
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: returns amountOut = amounts[path.length-1]; emits EthExchangedForZeta; downstream consumption not in this file.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Does the caller use returned amountOut as cross-chain credit without re-validation? If yes, severity High/Critical.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Cross-chain recipient receives less Zeta than ETH value warranted.

unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: swapExactETHForTokens called with destinationAddress passed directly; no validation dest==msg.sender/whitelist.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether caller is always rightful owner of destinationAddress — depends on calling context (intermediary contract).

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: MAX_DEADLINE=200s, non-zero; router enforces; miner timestamp manipulation ~15s << 200s.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Deadline functional; stale-price risk subsumed by sandwich mechanism.

impact_direction.victim_loses: Caller receives near-zero output vs input when minAmountOut=0.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain value correctness: amountOut used as authoritative Zeta amount; sandwich reduces below true value. safeApprove DoS violates availability for all future callers.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Sandwich profit scales with swap size; DoS permanent affecting all; neither self-funded/dust/admin/timing.
